items.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%

sentences.en: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%.
sentences.zh: 我们如何将DNS构建延迟减半，并将内存使用量减少85%。

sentences.en: When I last wrote about our DNS propagation pipeline in 2022 , the Zone Builder received about 250 DNS record changes per second.
sentences.zh: 当我上次在2022年撰写有关DNS传播管道的文章时， Zone Builder每秒收到约250次DNS记录更改。

sentences.en: Today it receives about 700, nearly three times as many, plus about 100 other events, such as zone setting changes.
sentences.zh: 今天，它收到了大约700个，几乎是原来的三倍，加上大约100个其他事件，例如区域设置更改。

sentences.en: However, the number of events was never the real problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，事件的数量从来都不是真正的问题。

sentences.en: The problem was the kind of work some of those events needed, and how that work grows with the size of a zone.
sentences.zh: 问题在于这些活动所需的工作类型，以及这些工作如何随着区域的大小而增长。

sentences.en: Some zones now hold more than 20 million records, and we expect them to keep growing toward hundreds of millions.
sentences.zh: 一些区域现在拥有超过2000万条记录，我们预计它们将不断增长，达到数亿条。

sentences.en: Each event starts a clock that measures how long it takes us to turn that change into data our authoritative DNS servers can use.
sentences.zh: 每个事件都会启动一个时钟，用于衡量我们将更改转换为权威DNS服务器可以使用的数据所需的时间。

sentences.en: We call that work a build.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为构建。

sentences.en: A build reads the current database state, converts it into the format used at the edge, and writes any changes to Quicksilver .
sentences.zh: 构建读取当前数据库状态，将其转换为边缘使用的格式，并将任何更改写入Quicksilver。

sentences.en: In 2022, per-record builds were 150 times faster than full builds on average.
sentences.zh: 2022年，每个记录的构建平均比完整构建快150倍。

sentences.en: On a test zone with one million records, per-record builds were 4,250 times faster.
sentences.zh: 在一个拥有100万条记录的测试区域，每条记录的构建速度提高了4,250倍。

sentences.en: We ended that post with the obvious next step: do the same thing for zone settings.
sentences.zh: 我们以明显的下一步结束了这篇帖子：对区域设置执行相同的操作。
